revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a broad factory corridor with safety rails, distant machinery, and a clean matte concrete industrial floor under warm practical interior lighting. Front-oblique view at medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, and enough surrounding context to judge body support.
